title: Men in Black interrogation about the control panel at DIA

tellings.quote: it. And the guy over to the side slapped his leg and said, "So that's it."

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, says that in the late 1980s at the Defense Intelligence Agency he was questioned by men he calls Men in Black, the mysterious suited agents of UFO lore, about a control panel he had described. He tells Michels that when he finished explaining it, "the guy over to the side slapped his leg and said, 'So that's it,'" which suggests they had been trying to work out what the panel was. He mentions a man named Ed Dames in telling it.
